title: Yoneda coefficient splice versus the signed localization boundary
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $j:W=T-Z\hookrightarrow T$ its open complement [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $0\to G_1\to G_2\to G_3\to0$ be a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $h\in G_3(W)$. Work in their ordinary derived category and Ext groups [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-pc-ext]. Put $F=i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ and let $e_h\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_T(F,G_3)$ be the pushout of
$$0\to j_!\mathbf Z_W\to\mathbf Z_T\to F\to0$$
[lem-weil-pbc-open-closed-short-exact] along the map $j_!\mathbf Z_W\to G_3$ adjoint to $1\mapsto h$. Let $k\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_T(G_3,G_1)$ be the extension class of the coefficient sequence, and let $\delta_W:G_3(W)\to H^1(W,G_1)$ be its ordinary connecting map. For a nonnegative injective resolution $G_1\to J$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], let $H^q_Z(T,G_1)$ be derived kernel-of-restriction cohomology [def-pur-etale-derived-supported-sections]. Use the supported-Hom identification [lem-amb-closed-support-hom] and the signed relative realization [def-amb-relative-etale-cohomology, lem-pur-divisor-torsor-boundary-signs]
$$C^q=J^q(T)\oplus J^{q-1}(W),\qquad D(a,b)=(da,\operatorname{res}(a)-db),\qquad \partial[b]=[(0,-b)].$$
Normalize this identification on the kernel complex by sending a cocycle $z:F\to J^q$ to $(z\circ p,0)$, where $p:\mathbf Z_T\to F$. Then the Yoneda splice, in the order $k[1]\circ e_h:F\to G_1[2]$, corresponds to
$$\partial\bigl(\delta_W(h)\bigr)\in H^2_Z(T,G_1).$$
This is a positive equality. It concerns the Yoneda splice, with its derived shift, rather than the termwise connecting map of the short exact sequence of signed relative complexes. It holds for arbitrary $G_a$, including nontorsion $G_2,G_3$.
